archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Maru-Jan discloses breach affecting over 1.85 million members

entries.headline: Maru-Jan discloses unauthorized access affecting more than 1.85 million member email addresses
entries.summary: SignalTalk disclosed that online mahjong game Maru-Jan suffered unauthorized external access, exposing the email addresses of 1,855,578 members. The available evidence does not support expanding the affected-data claim beyond that category.
entries.verification: An opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays SignalTalk's disclosure and states the affected member count and email-address exposure.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 4:45 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Aniplex and CYBIRD announce dark-fantasy visual novel LunaReverse
entries.summary: Aniplex and CYBIRD announced LunaReverse, a revenge-themed dark-fantasy visual novel planned for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: Opened reports from AUTOMATON and 4Gamer independently agree on the title, partners and platforms.
entries.timeNote: The earliest selected report was published on November 7 at 5:35 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: NieR:Automata update bug raises installation requirement from about 50GB to 366.5GB
entries.summary: Square Enix said it is investigating a PC update issue that raises NieR:Automata's installation requirement from roughly 50GB to 366.5GB. As a temporary workaround, players are advised to deselect all eight DLC items before downloading the base game.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report directly quotes Square Enix's Steam notice on the issue, investigation and workaround.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 7:15 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Fate/Grand Order marks 100 million global downloads with a pick-one five-star Servant campaign
entries.summary: FGO PROJECT announced a 100-million-global-download campaign starting at 9:00 PM JST on November 7. Eligible players can select one of 43 permanent or story-summon five-star Servants, with rewards including up to 100 Saint Quartz.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays FGO PROJECT's announcement and lists the start time, selection pool and rewards.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 7:41 PM Beijing time; the campaign time is stated in Japan Standard Time.

entries.headline: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim: Probably Stolen passes one million sales about 10 days after launch
entries.summary: tinyBuild announced that Questing Goose Studio's Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim has sold more than one million copies. The PC game launched on Steam on October 28 and reached the milestone in roughly 10 days.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly attributes the fixed sales milestone to tinyBuild; mutable Steam review figures were not used.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 10:16 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Romance-suspense visual novel Algorithm Prescription targets 2028 on Switch 2 and PC
entries.summary: Shochiku Games announced that Algorithm Prescription is planned for release in 2028 on Nintendo Switch 2 and PC via Steam. A PC demo is currently available.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Shochiku Games' platform and release-year update.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 2:55 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story schedules a major free story update and PC DLC for November 25
entries.summary: Nestopi announced anniversary content for Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story. Free story update Kimi to Miru Yume arrives on PC, iOS and Android on November 25; paid DLC Room & Cozy Activity launches on PC the same day, with mobile versions planned for early December.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Nestopi's anniversary announcement and its platform-specific dates.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 10:00 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Eight-player armed ski racer Snow Panic announced for PC in Q1 2027
entries.summary: Developer KAFI announced Snow Panic, an online armed ski-racing game for up to eight players. It is planned for release on PC via Steam in the first quarter of 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays KAFI's announcement and states the player count, platform and release window.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 12:09 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft Forever's first team reaches level 60 three days after launch
entries.summary: IGN reports that a team led by JokerD became the first World of Warcraft Forever group to reach level 60, about three days after launch. The first raids are scheduled to open on December 9.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report identifies the team, level, elapsed launch time and first-raid date; the item remains a single-media community report.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 11:12 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Football Manager 27's 100-hour preview finds major improvements to its predecessor's UI
entries.summary: After roughly 100 hours with Football Manager 27, an AUTOMATON writer reports major improvements to the previous game's criticized tiles-and-cards interface. The portal now surfaces messages, news, fixtures, league tables and player statistics directly, while more information can be viewed full-screen instead of through narrow, scroll-heavy cards.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON feature directly compares Football Manager 26 and Football Manager 27 and describes the portal and full-screen information changes.
entries.timeNote: The feature was published on November 7 at 11:00 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Star Wars: Zero Company developer Bit Reactor lays off an undisclosed number of staff
entries.summary: PC Gamer reports that Star Wars: Zero Company developer Bit Reactor laid off an undisclosed number of employees after an earlier furlough and partial rehiring. Several designers disclosed their departures on LinkedIn, including senior environment artist Ryan Lopez; the available evidence does not establish an exact layoff count.
entries.verification: The opened PC Gamer report cites Bespin Bulletin and employee LinkedIn posts, supporting the layoffs, Ryan Lopez's inclusion and the undisclosed headcount without adding a specific figure.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 7 at 8:18 PM Beijing time.
